text: {"lessons":["I sold several stocks at gains, but locking in a profit feels good without proving it was the best decision; I should judge each trade by my overall plan, not the satisfaction of realizing gains.","My average cost is a reference point, not a reason to keep a losing position or sell a winning one; I should avoid treating each stock as a separate account.","Doing nothing in some periods is acceptable: with prices moving randomly, I should trade only when my portfolio needs rebalancing or my goals change, not because of recent price moves."]}
